description: How exposed is a country's diet to the current world price of its main staple?. Joins FAOSTAT food balance (calories, top staple, cereal self-sufficiency) with the World Bank Pink Sheet price of that staple (latest month, y/y, 5y, 12-month range) and the country's food CPI, plus a computed exposure flag. Computed by Lilambd. Routes: /answer (country*, limit); /countries (limit). Paid $0.5 USDC per call via x402 (_meta["x402/payment"]); set sample=true for a free 3-row preview.

route.description: One of: /answer, /countries. Replace {placeholders} with a value, e.g. /search or /HND.

name: staple-price-shock
